EVENTS.KINGDOM_WELCOME: The Kingdom acknowledges your hard work in establishing your settlement!
EVENTS.KINGDOM_GENERIC_APPROVE: I am but your humble servant.
EVENTS.RUSTIC_CHURCH_BUILT_DESC: Words of your village's first church have reached the Clergy. They appreciate your dedication to the Faith and thus hold you in higher regard!
EVENTS.RUSTIC_CHURCH_BUILT_CHOICE_A: We are pious servants of the Faith.
EVENTS.RUSTIC_CHURCH_BUILT_CHOICE_TOOLTIP: Your Influence over the Clergy will increase.
EVENTS.RUSTIC_CHURCH_BUILT_CHOICE_DESC: The construction of your first church increased your Influence with the Clergy.
EVENTS.TRADEROUTE_NORTHBURY_1_DESC: Thanks to your increasing trades, many folks are now looking to settle in Northbury, yet the village struggles to feed the extra workforce and asks if you could send them much-needed bread.
EVENTS.TRADEROUTE_NORTHBURY_2_DESC: Northbury is growing into a bustling village! Its people are planning workshops to process the additional goods you traded, yet they lack food to feed the necessary builders and would like you to contribute.
EVENTS.TRADEROUTE_NORTHBURY_3_DESC: Northbury is quickly becoming a prosperous city! To accommodate more goods, they are planning to build a Town Hall. However, they are struggling to provide enough food for the necessary builders and could use your help.
EVENTS.TRADEROUTE_NORTHBURY_R_DESC: Northbury is building another district! They want to handle more trading goods, yet need bread to feed the extra builders. They wonder if your village could assist them.
EVENTS.TRADEROUTE_NORTHBURY_QUEST_SUCCESS_DESC: Northbury promised this shipment of food would be the cornerstone of your mutual wealth! As long as no one starts mixing bread and mortar, that is.
EVENTS.TRADEROUTE_GENERIC_QUEST_SUCCESS_DESC: Your neighbour thanked you for your patronage! They promised that the goods of your village would soon flow right into their markets!
EVENTS.TRADEROUTE_CHOICE_YES_TOOLTIP: The neighbouring village will expect you to eventually help them by sending resources through a mandate.
EVENTS.TRADEROUTE_CHOICE_LATER_TOOLTIP: You can improve the Trade Route by sending them resources through a mandate.
EVENTS.ONBOARDING_WELCOME_DESC:
After a long journey throughout the realm, your people finally reach new lands. Your lands. Territories you can settle for reasons of your own. 

Your villagers await your command and are eager to offer advice about how to proceed, should you require it.
EVENTS.ONBOARDING_TERRITORY_DESC:
The first piece of advice comes from the eldest of your villagers. He suggests you consider basic needs when settling down. 

Berries for your people. Stone and wood for your construction efforts. The rest will find its way.
EVENTS.ONBOARDING_PRODUCTION_DESC:
The second piece of advice comes from a young, enterprising villager. Rather than letting everyone fend for themselves, she suggests that you organise labourers into appropriate workplaces. 

Builders into workshops, woodcutters into lumber camps, berry gatherers into their huts, and so on.
EVENTS.ONBOARDING_VILLAGERNEEDS_DESC:
Now that you have organised your labourers, you can tend to their Needs and Happiness. Make sure they have access to fresh water and housing. As for food, you will first need people to store and distribute the berries they collected. 

From there, your village will have everything needed to welcome its first wave of immigrants!
EVENTS.ONBOARDING_TRADE_DESC:
A business-minded villager proposes creating a trade route with your closest neighbour, Northbury, to sell resources for profit and obtain items that cannot be produced locally. 

Northbury needs planks, so you should start with those.
EVENTS.ONBOARDING_ADMINISTRATION_DESC:
You've made great strides recently! A light-hearted woman recognises your progress and thanks you on behalf of her folks for your hard work. 

To help manage the village and enact new mandates, she suggests building a Manor House and a Great Hall.
EVENTS.ONBOARDING_ADMINISTRATION_CHOICE_A: It will be a grand manor.
EVENTS.ONBOARDING_ENDING_DESC:
You stroll through the village and look at what you've achieved. This land was a mere wilderness not long ago, but you came along and made a difference. You and your people turned this untamed territory into a respectable land of the realm. 

And this is just the beginning, for your fair rule will bring prosperity to all!
EVENTS.ONBOARDING_CHOICE_ADVISE: Let's put this advice into practice.
EVENTS.ONBOARDING_CHOICE_LEAVE: I will continue on my own.
EVENTS.ONBOARDING_CHOICE_LEAVE_TOOLTIP: Dismiss this advice and resume your work.
EVENTS.ONBOARDING_CHOICE_INTRO_LEAVE_TOOLTIP: Dismiss this advice and start your work.
EVENTS.ONBOARDING_CHOICE_A_TOOLTIP: Follow the advice of your villagers and learn how to rule your village.
EVENTS.ONBOARDING_CHOICE_COMPLETE_TOOLTIP: Start ruling the village on your own.
EVENTS.ONBOARDING_FIRSTTERRITORY_QUEST_DESC: I have arrived in promising lands which I have to settle.
EVENTS.ONBOARDING_VILLAGECENTER_QUEST_DESC: Now that I've decided where to settle, I must establish the Village Centre.
EVENTS.ONBOARDING_BUILDERWORKSHOP_QUEST_DESC: Before constructing anything, I have to decide where the Builders will work.
EVENTS.ONBOARDING_ASSIGNBUILDER_QUEST_DESC: Now that the first workplace is set, I have to assign villagers to work there.
EVENTS.ONBOARDING_PLACEWOODCUTTER_QUEST_DESC: I have to build a Lumber Camp to acquire wood for the village's construction.
EVENTS.ONBOARDING_ASSIGNWOODCUTTER_QUEST_DESC: The wood won't cut itself. I should assign Woodcutters to the Lumber Camp.
EVENTS.ONBOARDING_PAINTEXTRACTION_QUEST_DESC: I have to inform the Woodcutters about which resources to extract.
EVENTS.ONBOARDING_PRODUCEBERRY_QUEST_DESC: My people are getting hungry! They would like a Gathering Hut by the woods to collect berries.
EVENTS.ONBOARDING_RESIDENTIAL_QUEST_DESC: I have to decide where my people are going to build their houses.
EVENTS.ONBOARDING_FILLNEEDS_QUEST_DESC: I must ensure that all needs are fulfilled now that everyone is settling down.
EVENTS.ONBOARDING_FIRSTIMMIGRATION_QUEST_DESC: I have to make sure the village has everything newcomers need to immigrate.
EVENTS.ONBOARDING_WAREHOUSE_QUEST_DESC: I have to ensure construction materials are stored for workers and traders alike.
EVENTS.ONBOARDING_TRADEROUTE_QUEST_DESC: I should prepare a Trade Route to benefit from exchanges with neighbouring villages.
EVENTS.ONBOARDING_MANOR_QUEST_DESC: To administer the village, I should build a Manor House with a Great Hall.
EVENTS.ONBOARDING_COMPLETION_DESC: Your villagers don't have anything else to teach you... yet! As you face new challenges, they will offer additional advice.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_PROSPERITY_DESC: Your villagers would enjoy decorations! They will increase the Desirability of an area for better housing and also provide Beautification, which improves your Prosperity.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_PROSPERITY_QUEST_DESC: I have agreed to learn how to decorate our village.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_TAXATIONLOWCOINS_DESC: It seems your treasury has been low on coins lately. Some of your villagers suggest temporarily increasing taxes until the treasury improves.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_TAXATIONLOWCOINS_QUES: I have agreed to learn how to increase taxes to collect more coins.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_TAXATIONLOWHAPPINESS_: Life is difficult for the townsfolk! Some of your people hope you reduce their tax burden to make their lives easier, at least for a little while, so they can manage to fulfil their needs.
I have agreed to learn how to lower taxes to make my villagers happier.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_CHOICE_A_TOOLTIP: Follow a piece of advice from your villagers and learn something new about your village.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_CHOICE_LEAVE_TOOLTIP: Dismiss this advice and resume your work.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_PROSPERITY_COMPLETION: You have placed your first decoration! Decorations provide both Beautification and Desirability, which improves your village.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_TAXATIONLOWCOINS_COMP: You increased taxation and earned more coins! Keep an eye out to find the ideal balance between wealth and happiness.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_TAXATIONLOWHAPPINESS_: You reduced taxation and made your villagers happier! Keep an eye out to find the ideal balance between wealth and happiness.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_LABOURINFLUENCE_ACCUM: An isolated community of fishermen is looking for a kind-hearted builder! They need help constructing a bridge to connect their village to the rest of the Realm. They don't have much to offer, but they promise to spread the word about your generosity amongst the labourers.
My best builder will draw you a blueprint.
Your best builder will attempt to draw a bridge blueprint for the fishermen.
Let me hire someone on your behalf!
You will invest a token amount of coins to help out the fishermen.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_LABOURINFLUENCE_SPEND: The fishermen are thankful for the blueprint, as a bridge will help bring their community to the forefront. As thanks, they would like to trade a fair number of fish for some of your stones.
A most generous offer, thank you.
Trade a small amount of stones for a large number of fish.
Trade? I just gave you a bridge.
You will use your Influence to earn the fish without giving anything in return.
Keep the fish. I don't need them.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_LABOURINFLUENCE_ACCUM: You helped the small community build a bridge, and they promised to spread the word in return.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_LABOURINFLUENCE_SPEND: The fishermen handed over a fair amount of goods as thanks for the bridge blueprint.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_LABOURINFLUENCE_ACCUM: I have accepted an offer from a fishing community to exchange stones for their fish.
EVENTS.ESTATETRADER_WHEAT_LABOUR_DESC: The Elders are looking for wheat to help a nearby village running low on food. One of their merchants saw your farm and wants to make you an offer.
EVENTS.ESTATETRADER_WOOD_LABOUR_DESC: The Elders are looking to repair a few bridges across the region. One of their merchants noticed your woodcutting camps and wants to make you an offer.
EVENTS.ESTATETRADER_HAGGLE_FAILURE_DESC: The negotiations failed! The merchant is now offering a lesser deal compared to the initial proposition.
EVENTS.ESTATETRADER_HAGGLE_SUCCESS_DESC: The negotiations succeeded! The merchant is now offering a much better deal compared to the original.
EVENTS.ESTATETRADER_QUEST_FAILURE_DESC: You did not deliver the merchandise on time! The merchant did not appreciate that.
EVENTS.ESTATETRADER_QUEST_SUCCESS_DESC: You delivered the goods on time, much to the merchant's delight, who promised to put a good word in with their leader.
EVENTS.ESTATETRADER_CHOICE_YES: This sounds like a good trade.
EVENTS.ESTATETRADER_WHEAT_LABOUR_QUEST_DESC: I have agreed to deliver a shipment of wheat to the Elders.
EVENTS.ESTATETRADER_WOOD_LABOUR_QUEST_DESC: I have agreed to deliver a shipment of wood to the Elders.
EVENTS.ESTATETRADER_CHOICE_YES_TOOLTIP: The Estate expects a large number of resources to be delivered within a month.
EVENTS.ESTATETRADER_CHOICE_HAGGLE_TOOLTIP: The Estate is not interested in lowering its offer, but you can attempt to persuade them.
EVENTS.ESTATETRADER_CHOICE_LATER_TOOLTIP: The deal is off, but the Estate will return later.
EVENTS.TOWNTALE_BERRYSURPLUS_DESC: A mountain of food in your granary is always a reassuring sight. Such an abundance of nourishing wealth comforts your villagers, assuring them that the days ahead will likely involve being well-fed.
EVENTS.TOWNTALE_COINSURPLUS_DESC: Rumour has it you managed to gather a fortune akin to the dragons of yore: a tremendous pile of shiny gold coins. It may be hearsay, yet your folk take comfort knowing they won't lack riches for quite some time.
EVENTS.TOWNTALE_FIRSTBAKERY_DESC: A delicious aroma drifts upon the warm wind this morning. It's your village's first bundle of bread, fresh out of the oven, to the delight of every villager and their tingling taste buds!
EVENTS.TOWNTALE_FULLHAPPINESS_DESC: From your seat in the Great Hall, you can hear people singing and laughing outside. You ensured everyone had everything necessary for their contentment and success! Thanks to you, life is good.
EVENTS.TOWNTALE_MATERIALSURPLUS_DESC: Wood and stone. With these, anything is possible. Your villagers look at the surplus and marvel at their potential. Will it be a church? A manor? A tavern? Excitedly, everyone ponders what might come next!
EVENTS.TOWNTALE_POSITIVE_TOOLTIP: Your villagers are rejoicing over this story!
EVENTS.TOWNTALE_INFLUENCE_TOOLTIP: You earned praise from an Estate of the realm!
EVENTS.TOWNTALE_TRADE_TOOLTIP: You obtained better deals from traders!
EVENTS.TOWNTALE_FIRSTTAXOFFICE_DESC: A Tax Office now stands in the village, promising order and prosperity! Though some villagers might grumble, they know their coins are paving the way to a brighter, safer future for all.
EVENTS.TOWNTALE_POPULATION100_DESC: You've welcomed 100 villagers to your growing community! While still small, the spirit of cooperation shines through. It is a hopeful beginning as you lay the foundation for future dreams.
EVENTS.TOWNTALE_POPULATION200_DESC: Rejoice in the streets! With 200 villagers, your hamlet is thriving! Your homes are becoming sturdier, and the marketplace is lively with activity. There is a comforting sense of progress as life here becomes richer.
EVENTS.TOWNTALE_POPULATION300_DESC: Huzzah for 300! Your village is now brimming with opportunities, allowing fellowships to deepen and skills to develop, and hailed as a warm and inviting place for everyone to enjoy.
EVENTS.TOWNTALE_POPULATION400_DESC: Let the banners fly! Your village has transformed into a grand city of 400! The streets are alive with nattering neighbours, and the bonds you have created make this city a perfect place to call home.
EVENTS.TOWNTALE_POPULATION500_DESC: Over 500 villagers now call your city home. A remarkable achievement! You've created a vibrant community that stands proudly among the realm's grandest. The future holds much promise and adventure for everyone.
EVENTS.TOWNTALE_ADVANCEDMATERIALSURPLUS_DESC: Your artisans have been hard at work, and now, the village has a surplus of polished stones and planks! This newfound abundance has sparked their creativity, fostering ideas of incredible structures yet to come.
EVENTS.TOWNTALE_REFINEDSURPLUS_DESC: Thanks to a surplus of refined food, every meal in the village feels like a gourmet experience! This abundance guarantees delightful victuals for the entire community.
EVENTS.TOWNTALE_TOOLSSURPLUS_DESC: The village's abundance of tools stirs all industrious minds! Will they create new wonders, trade for wealth, or improve daily life? Your people await your decision.
EVENTS.TOWNTALE_TRADEVOLUME_DESC: Traders are impressed by the lucrative business they enjoy each time they visit your village! As a token of their appreciation, they're offering better prices for a while, ensuring more advantageous deals.
EVENTS.LABOURWELCOME_DESC:
The Elders, the much respected leading men and women among the region's labourers, heard of your village and wished to make themselves useful to your people. 

They brought welcoming gifts - mainly tools - to ease your villager's lot, then pledged their assistance.
EVENTS.LABOURWELCOME_CHOICE_DESC: The Elders want you to take good care of your people.
EVENTS.LABOURWELCOME_CHOICE_A_TOOLTIP: The Elders will send tools to help your village.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_NOTOOLS_DESC: You ran out of tools! These precious goods are necessary for most construction efforts. Your people suggest you buy some from neighbouring villages. They won't come cheap, but it's the best you can do until you acquire a Blacksmith.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_NOTOOLS_CHOICE_A_TOOL: Open up a trade route and buy a few tools from a neighbouring village.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_NOTOOLS_COMPLETION_DE: These tools should last a while! Having asked for more than you own, traders will stock the difference in your warehouses.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_NOTOOLS_QUEST_DESC: I have agreed to buy tools from a neighbouring village.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_SECONDFOOD_DESC: Your villagers are very grateful for the food you provided them, yet they wish their larder had more to offer! They would greatly appreciate it if you were to give them a second source of food.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_SECONDFOOD_CHOICE_A: Let's put food on the table.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_SECONDFOOD_CHOICE_A_T: You will provide a second source of food to your villagers.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_SECONDFOOD_COMPLETION: Your villagers are happy to have multiple sources of food available. Diversification also ensures food stability.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_SECONDFOOD_QUEST_DESC: I have promised to find my people a second source of food.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_ENACTLEVY_DESC:
Your treasury appears to be low these days! As the leader of this village, you have the authority to collect funds from your villagers. However, contributions will be reluctant! 

Levies should only be used in urgent situations, as they can significantly decrease your villagers' Happiness over several weeks.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_ENACTLEVY_CHOICE_A: Let's ask the villagers for coins.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_ENACTLEVY_COMPLETION_: You levied emergency funds from your villagers, which made them unhappy.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_ENACTLEVY_QUEST_DESC: I have decided to levy funds from my villagers.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_VILLAGERLEAVING_DESC: Some villagers in your community are unhappy. They have their reasons, but one thing is clear: they will leave if life in your village does not improve. Check to see what is bothering them.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_VILLAGERLEAVING_COMPL: Peace has returned to the village, and everyone is merry once again.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_VILLAGERLEAVING_QUEST: I have decided to encourage villagers to stay.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_HOUSEDENSITYINCREASE_: Villagers are happy to learn about your plans to enhance fortifications and carry out patrols! They believe this will increase the village's density and foster prosperity for the entire community.
Let's make a city out of this village!
The roads are finally safe, paving the way for a denser village. Just make sure to assign more patrollers as it grows!
I have agreed to improve the safety of the village.
EVENTS.TOOLSLOAN_OFFER_DESC: A wealthy benefactor learned of your village's recent struggles with tools and coins! They've graciously offered to lend you the necessary tools to help your community flourish. However, they will eventually expect repayment.
EVENTS.TOOLSLOAN_OFFER_CHOICE_A: Thank you. That is very generous of you.
EVENTS.TOOLSLOAN_OFFER_CHOICE_A_TOOLTIP: You will receive tools, but the benefactor expects payment, eventually.
EVENTS.TOOLSLOAN_OFFER_CHOICE_NO: No thanks, we will be fine without them.
EVENTS.TOOLSLOAN_OFFER_CHOICE_NO_TOOLTIP: The benefactor might offer his help again in the future.
EVENTS.TOOLSLOAN_OFFER_GIVEN_DESC: You received a shipment of tools from a noble benefactor.
EVENTS.TOOLSLOAN_OFFER_PAID_DESC: You paid back the noble benefactor for the tools they lent you.
EVENTS.TOOLSLOAN_OPPORTUNITY_WAIT_DESC: A merchant wished to help with your noticeable lack of tools and coins.
EVENTS.TOOLSLOAN_QUEST_DESC: I promised a benefactor I would repay them for the tools they gave us.
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_KINGDOM_STEP_4_QUEST_OBJECTIV: Host the King at your Castle
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_MONASTERY_STEP_4_QUEST_OBJECT: Host the Abbess at your Monastery
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_LABOR_HOSTING_QUEST_OBJECTIVE: Host the Seneschal at your Tavern
EVENTS.ASPIRATION_CAPITAL_HOSTING_QUEST_OBJECTI: Host the Assembly of the Estates at your Capital
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_UPGRADINGTRADEROUTE_D: You have traded enough with Northbury for them to want to expand their village, but they need your help to accomplish this! Hire an assistant to send them what they need, and you will profit more from trading.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_UPGRADINGTRADEROUTE_C: You will need to hire an assistant and send Northbury a shipment of bread.
You improved your first Trade Route! Every Trade Route requires specific resources and has estate-specific mandates.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_UPGRADINGTRADEROUTE_Q: I promised I would delegate someone to deliver a shipment of bread to Northbury.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_STARTINGMANORHOUSE_DE: The villagers were concerned they might not have enough coins to develop a prosperous village. After much deliberation, they decided to build a Tax Office and contribute by sharing some of their earnings through a house tax.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_STARTINGMANORHOUSE_CH: Every villager will contribute to the community!
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_STARTINGMANORHOUSE_QU: I have agreed to collect taxes by building a Tax Office in the Manor House.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_STARTINGMANORHOUSE_CO: The first coins have been collected! It is important to remember that high taxes will eventually make your people unhappy.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_WOODCUTTEREXPANSION_D: Your woodcutters can't keep up with the demand! Exhausted, they plea for more villagers to help. They also suggest recruiting a forester as it would ensure ample forests in the future.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_WOODCUTTEREXPANSION_C: With these new workers, wood will flow once more! Building Improvements is a great way to earn Labour Splendour while densifying your workplaces.
EVENTS.ADVANCEDONBOARDING_WOODCUTTEREXPANSION_Q: I have agreed to develop our wood production.
EVENTS.ONBOARDING_EXPANSION_DESC: I need to expand my territory if I am to grow my village.
EVENTS.ONBOARDING_MARKET_DESC: I need to design and build a market to ensure my villagers have access to food.
EVENTS.EVENT_START_ROYAL_DUTIES: Begin your Royal Duties attending the Royal Companies.

DEMO.END_OF_DEMO_TEXT:
If you're interested in purchasing the game, Foundation is currently available on Steam as an Early Access title. 

You can also grab a discounted copy during the Salon du Jeu et du Jouet by inquiring with our staff.

Your villagers eagerly await your next visit!
